gbm_population_evidence.quote: Diagnosed with glioblastoma (GBM) deemed to be potentially resectable and who are deemed to be good candidate for postoperative adjuvant chemo and radiation therapy.

candidate_evidence.quote: [BIOLOGICAL] TH-1 Dendritic Cell Immunotherapy: Adult patients with histopathologically diagnosed glioblastoma will be eligible for this novel, personalized dendritic cell vaccine after completing standard of care chemoradiation.
Use of non-standard post-operative treatment regimen, as defined by the Stupp protocol: postoperative chemoradiation and initiation of temozolomide (TMZ).

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: A Phase I Study of Th-1 Dendritic Cell Immunotherapy in Combination With Standard Chemoradiation for the Adjuvant Treatment of Adult Glioblastoma

role_evidence.quote: [BIOLOGICAL] TH-1 Dendritic Cell Immunotherapy: Adult patients with histopathologically diagnosed glioblastoma will be eligible for this novel, personalized dendritic cell vaccine after completing standard of care chemoradiation.

role_evidence.quote: Use of non-standard post-operative treatment regimen, as defined by the Stupp protocol: postoperative chemoradiation and initiation of temozolomide (TMZ).

Standard of care chemotherapy and radiation therapy shall be followed as per routine neuro-oncologic paradigms after which patients enrolled into this study will receive a personalized vaccine beyond standard of care.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, standard Stupp chemoradiation backbone
arms: Dendritic cell vaccine dose escalation one
Dendritic cell vaccine dose escalation two

coder_notes: Only investigational intervention is a dendritic cell vaccine (excluded type). Temozolomide is not a registered intervention but all patients follow the Stupp protocol (exclusion criterion 2), so listed as soc_backbone. The four registered arms are dose-escalation/de-escalation cohorts of the same vaccine (design SINGLE_GROUP), none a control; coded control_arm_from_other_arms 'no' (could be read as not_applicable given single-group design).
